as_told.title: Anonymous Navy scientist on extended electrodynamics in Townsend Brown episode

plain: A top Navy scientist, staying anonymous for fear of punishment from his superiors, supposedly described a theory called extended electrodynamics, a broader version of the 19th-century equations of electricity and magnetism worked out by the physicists James Clerk Maxwell and Oliver Heaviside. Michels tells this himself, saying he learned about the theory from this scientist and interviewed him in his own video about Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor who experimented with electrical propulsion, a video he also calls The Man Who Built UFOs for the CIA. Across three episodes he brings it up again, once calling the source a Navy whistleblower. If the theory holds, it could point to new physics behind how such craft might move.
